fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) fell 30% early in week but rebounded 4.4% Friday morning; as top-5 global NAND flash memory producer, post-election data center regulation concerns drove main decline.
fields.summary_ko.1: Citigroup forecasts continued supply-demand imbalance with 22% memory production growth vs. 26% demand growth expected in 2027; at current valuation (less than 4x 2027 expected earnings), limited downside value.
